purpose: bounded synthetic signed-action response learning ablation; not a B-completion result

source.safe_definition: retained_candidate_mask & static_found & view_projection_feasible & finite signed-contact features

simulator_assumptions.fit: least squares on detected uncensored values with one nuisance offset per training subject; misses/censored values are not imputed
simulator_assumptions.heldout: site_index mod 5 == 0, checked 19-degree pose, and two subjects never enter selection/fitting

contrast_family.direction_definition: feature(noncentral checked contact) - feature(same-site same-pose checked center); plus 15deg center - 0deg center
contrast_family.heldout_oblique_definition: all safe noncentral checked +/- lateral offsets and +/-12-degree tilts at 19 degrees minus same-site 19-degree center
contrast_family.bias_cancellation: session zero offset cancels within each same-site contrast
